parsed.note_claim: The regular Kyiv-Warsaw passenger train was struck by a drone, while politicians like Boris Johnson and Günter Sautter were on a separate chartered train that was not hit but was stopped near the border as a precaution.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Sautter, reiste demnach in der Nacht mit einem privat gecharterten Zug von Kiew nach Polen. Am frühen Morgen sei der Zug dann nahe der polnischen Grenze gestoppt, wegen Drohnen seien Teile des Zuges evakuiert worden.
parsed.reason: The page reports a drone hit the locomotive of the Kyiv-Warsaw passenger train, while Sautter and Johnson were on a separate privately chartered train that was stopped near the border and all came away unharmed.
